title: Part Twenty-Seven: Moving: Travel, the Border and the Exit

sections.brief: Secure Flight (2008 rule; fields; No Fly/Selectee; retention 7 days/7 years/99 years; 'does not use algorithms to assign risk scores'); Quiet Skies ended 5 Jun 2025 ('political rolodex', Gabbard, ~$200m/yr); APIS pre-departure (2008; 'not-cleared'); PNR contents and EU-US 5+10-year retention (EDPS 'clearly disproportionate'); ATS 15-year retention and inputs; Guardian 2014-22 APIS/SEVIS searches in Palantir; CBP entry-exit rule (27 Oct 2025, eff. 26 Dec 2025, citizens voluntary); TSA face checks (84 airports, opt-out 'without recourse', deletion, Touchless ID 24h; AJL 74%; TPPA not enacted); REAL ID 7 May 2025 and $45 ConfirmID (1 Feb 2026); CLEAR (Clear Secure, not Thomson Reuters CLEAR): history, founder control, 38.0m/7.6m members, $900.8m, privacy notice (faceprints/iris; legal process; TSA for CLEAR+; no sale of biometrics), RT/SAFETY Act/PreCheck enrolment/CMS Medicare.gov contract, 2022 ammo incident; Secure Flight to ICE: NYT 12 Dec 2025, May 2025 MOA (American Oversight), Reuters 31,000 records/800+ arrests. Figures: compare, flow

8 USC 1185(b) passport as exit permit; Kent v. Dulles (1958), Aptheker (1964), Haig v. Agee (1981, 7-2); watchlist ~2m (2023), no-fly count not public; Latif (2014), 2015 revision, Kashem (2019), Fikre (2024, unanimous, mootness only); IRC 7345 $66,000 (2026) with exclusions and review; 42 USC 652(k) $2,500 (from $5,000, DRA 2005), ~$621m collected, H.R. 6903 passed House 27 Apr 2026, in Senate Finance; 22 USC 2714; Mast 'material support' passport clause struck Sept 2025; trusted traveller as leverage: New York 2020 ('inaccurate and misleading') and Cleland 2026 (face ID, revocation 3 days later, EPIC suit, CBP denial, untested); comparators: Soviet exit visas/refuseniks, 1972 diploma fees and Jackson-Vanik; China exit bans (Safeguard Defenders 2023); Russia 2023 e-summons ban and 2025 FSB access; If it were connected (graded joins); worst-case test for the part.
